# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Path and glyph correctness**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.156 updates correct clipped paths, glyph replay, and Graphite pixel readback without changing managed APIs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **More robust path rasterization and clipping** — Corrects convex-path rasterization at clip boundaries and guards against fixed-point overflow and invalid run lengths. Also fixes Ganesh path bounds and coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617))
- **Validated glyph replay** — Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds, and flags, preserves creation-time rounding during direct-mask replay, and bounds mask offsets. Retains rendering fallbacks when glyph data or atlas filtering is unsuitable. ([#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624), [#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617))
- **Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback corrected** — Uses an opaque RGBA destination when reading an alpha texture into an RGBx color type, preventing incorrect row stepping and unwritten pixel bytes. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
